details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept: a scoped name squatted at sentinel version 99.0.1 whose postinstall hook runs `node beacon.cjs`, and whose index.js fires the same beacon when the module is imported. The beacon POSTs a small JSON body to hxxp://13[.]140[.]137[.]222:8787/_ah/dc (header x-beacon-package) containing only the package name, hostname, install path, working directory and Node version — it reads no environment variables, tokens, credential files or wallet data, drops no files and runs no remote code. The exported module is a catch-all Proxy no-op shim so that builds importing the name complete and the install callback still fires. The README states it is part of an authorized dependency-confusion test, and the callback endpoint is the only network destination the package contacts.
